Full_Prompt_Or_Script_Body: SUBJECT: Quick correction on our earlier message (+ our apologies!) — [COMPANY_NAME] || EMAIL: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME],      I am reaching out personally because our system just sent you an automated message regarding [ERRONEOUS_MESSAGE_TOPIC] that contained an error on our end, and I wanted to correct it immediately so there is zero confusion.      Here is what happened and the accurate information for your records:     • What was sent in error: [DESCRIPTION_OF_ERROR]     • The correct details: [ACCURATE_CORRECTED_INFORMATION]      I have already fixed the setting on our end so this won't happen again. Because clear, reliable communication is something we take pride in—and because this error was 100% our fault—I have applied a [GOODWILL_GESTURE] to your account (#[JOB_ID]).      Here is your updated, verified link: [CORRECTED_LINK_URL]      Thank you for being a valued client of [COMPANY_NAME], and please reply directly to me if you have any questions!      Warm regards,     [OWNER_OR_MANAGER_NAME]     [COMPANY_NAME] | [COMPANY_PHONE] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], [OWNER_OR_MANAGER_NAME] at [COMPANY_NAME] here! Please disregard our automated text/email from a few minutes ago—it listed [ERROR_SHORT] by mistake. The correct info is [CORRECT_SHORT]. I've added a [GOODWILL_GESTURE] to your account for our mix-up! Updated link: [CORRECTED_LINK_URL] || INTERNAL NOTE: 🛠️ COMMUNICATION CORRECTION DISPATCHED — Client: [CUSTOMER_NAME] (#[JOB_ID]) | Root Cause: [ROOT_CAUSE_NOTE] | Fix Applied: Lookup table / filter patched in Make.com & [GOODWILL_GESTURE] logged on account.
Expected_Output_Schema: Synchronized Email Subject/Body + 160-char SMS/WhatsApp + Slack Internal Escalation Alert
Verification_Gate_Checklist: Pause the affected workflow scenario immediately and correct the underlying lookup table or filter rule so no second customer receives the error. | Own the mistake transparently within 30 minutes—never blame "a rogue computer bug" while refusing to honor reasonable goodwill.

Title: Unfair 1-Star Public Review Public Response & Private Resolution Bridge
Trigger_Condition: Triggered when **Prompt 7.3** detects a new `1-Star` or `2-Star` public review on Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, or Trustpilot (whether from a genuine dissatisfied customer or a non-customer/spam account).
Full_Prompt_Or_Script_Body: SUBJECT: Priority Account Update — [COMPANY_NAME] ([CUSTOMER_NAME] / [INVOICE_NUMBER]) || EMAIL: === VARIANT A: VERIFIED CLIENT PUBLIC RESPONSE === Hi [REVIEWER_NAME], thank you for bringing this to our attention. As the owner of [COMPANY_NAME], I hold our team to a high standard of communication and craftsmanship, and I am sorry your experience fell short of that mark. I have pulled our internal records for your visit and reached out to you directly by phone and email this morning so I can personally make this right. If you haven't seen my message yet, please call or text my direct line at [OWNER_DIRECT_PHONE] at your convenience. — [OWNER_NAME], Owner, [COMPANY_NAME]  === VARIANT B: UNRECOGNIZED / NON-CUSTOMER PUBLIC RESPONSE === Hi [REVIEWER_NAME], we take feedback very seriously at [COMPANY_NAME], and I immediately searched our customer database, scheduling logs, and billing records for your name and details. We have no record of ever performing service for you or speaking with you—it is possible you may have confused us with another company of a similar name outside our [CITY_NAME] service area. If you are a current client posting under a nickname, please reach out to me directly at [OWNER_DIRECT_PHONE] or [OWNER_EMAIL] with your work order date so I can investigate immediately! — [OWNER_NAME], Owner, [COMPANY_NAME] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], this is [OWNER_NAME], Owner of [COMPANY_NAME]. I just read your Google review and I want to thank you for your honesty and apologize for [ISSUE_SUMMARY]. I have already issued a [REFUND_OR_REMEDIATION_ACTION] and would love 3 minutes on the phone today at [OWNER_DIRECT_PHONE] to make sure we resolve this 100% to your satisfaction. || INTERNAL NOTE: ⭐🔴 1-STAR PUBLIC REVIEW TRIAGE — Reviewer: [REVIEWER_NAME] | Platform: Google | Match Status: [VERIFIED_OR_UNMATCHED] | Public response drafted & private outreach initiated by @[OWNER_NAME].
Expected_Output_Schema: Synchronized Email Subject/Body + 160-char SMS/WhatsApp + Slack Internal Escalation Alert
Verification_Gate_Checklist: **Never argue, get defensive, or disclose private client/PHI details publicly.** Remember: your public reply is written for the *next 1,000 prospects* reading your profile to see how calm, professional, and accountable you are. | Cross-reference your CRM/EHR/FSM database to verify whether the reviewer is an actual customer (`Verified Client` vs. `No Record Found / Wrong Business`). | Contact verified clients privately via phone/email first (using Emergency Script 01), then post the calm public bridge reply within 4 hours.

Title: Chargeback / Payment Dispute Evidence Summary & Amicable Resolution Outreach
Trigger_Condition: Triggered when Stripe, Square, or QuickBooks Payments fires a `charge.dispute.created` webhook indicating a customer has initiated a credit card chargeback (`Reason: Unrecognized`, `Service Not Provided`, or `Duplicate`).
Full_Prompt_Or_Script_Body: SUBJECT: Quick question regarding your [CARD_BRAND] card inquiry — Invoice #[INVOICE_NUMBER] ([COMPANY_NAME]) || EMAIL: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME],      Our accounting system just notified us that your credit card issuer ([CARD_BRAND] ending in *[CARD_LAST_4]) flagged a payment inquiry on [TRANSACTION_DATE] for [DISPUTED_AMOUNT] (Invoice #[INVOICE_NUMBER]).      Often, this happens automatically when a bank statement displays our registered corporate billing name ("[LEGAL_STATEMENT_DESCRIPTOR]") instead of our everyday trade name ("[COMPANY_NAME]") for the [WORK_SUMMARY] we completed for you on [SERVICE_DATE]!      For your convenience, I have attached a copy of your signed work order and itemized receipt (#[INVOICE_NUMBER]) showing what that charge covered.      • If this was just an unrecognized statement name: You can simply let your card issuer know you recognize the charge from [COMPANY_NAME] (or click one button in your banking app to cancel the dispute), which saves both of us a 60-day bank paperwork review.     • If you had any question or concern about the service or billing itself: Please reply directly to me here or call me at [OWNER_DIRECT_PHONE] today! As a local business, we can resolve any billing adjustment for you directly in 5 minutes rather than making you wait two months on credit card arbitration.      Warm regards,     [OWNER_OR_FINANCE_LEAD_NAME]     [COMPANY_NAME] | [COMPANY_PHONE] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], [OWNER_OR_FINANCE_LEAD_NAME] at [COMPANY_NAME] here. Your bank flagged the [DISPUTED_AMOUNT] charge from [TRANSACTION_DATE] (often because our statement name shows as "[LEGAL_STATEMENT_DESCRIPTOR]" for your [SERVICE_DATE] visit). I just emailed your receipt—if you have any billing question at all, text/call me here so I can help directly! || INTERNAL NOTE: 💳🚨 CHARGEBACK ALERT (`charge.dispute.created`) — Client: [CUSTOMER_NAME] | Amount: [DISPUTED_AMOUNT] | Inv #[INVOICE_NUMBER] | Bank Evidence Deadline: [EVIDENCE_DUE_DATE]. Automated 5-Point Evidence Packet compiled in Drive folder: [EVIDENCE_FOLDER_URL]. Amicable outreach sent; submit formal Stripe rebuttal in 48h if not withdrawn.
Expected_Output_Schema: Synchronized Email Subject/Body + 160-char SMS/WhatsApp + Slack Internal Escalation Alert
Verification_Gate_Checklist: Immediately compile the **5-Point Deterministic Evidence Packet** from your OS logs: (1) Signed Proposal/Intake IP & Timestamp, (2) Completed Work Order / Deliverable Proof & Photos, (3) Itemized Invoice PDF, (4) SMS/Email Thread Transcripts, and (5) Post-Visit Sentiment Check response. | Note that `65%+` of small business chargebacks happen because the customer **did not recognize your legal DBA descriptor on their credit card statement** (e.g., `"HVE HOLDINGS LLC"` instead of `"HarborView Electric"`). Reach out amicably within 2 hours before submitting formal dispute rebuttal.

Title: High-Value Client Sudden Cancellation / Churn-Risk Executive Save Outreach
Trigger_Condition: Triggered when a recurring retainer client, commercial maintenance member, or VIP customer submits a cancellation request, turns off auto-pay, or triggers a high churn-risk alert in **Prompt 7.5**.
Full_Prompt_Or_Script_Body: SUBJECT: Your account request + a personal note from me — [COMPANY_NAME] || EMAIL: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME],      I just saw your request to cancel/close your [MEMBERSHIP_OR_RETAINER_NAME] with [COMPANY_NAME], and I wanted to reach out personally.      First, so you have zero stress: I have received your request, confirmed your notice date as of today ([TODAY_DATE]), and ensured you will not be billed unexpectedly while we wrap things up.      Because we have truly valued partnering with [CUSTOMER_COMPANY] over the past [TENURE_MONTHS] months (where together we [SPECIFIC_HISTORICAL_WIN_OR_METRIC]), I wanted to ask one honest question and offer two flexible options in case they fit your current situation better than a full shutdown:      1. Was there anything in our recent execution, communication, or ROI that missed the mark? If so, I want to know personally—and if you're open to it, I'd like to step in personally to fix it at our expense.     2. Flexible Option A (60-Day Seasonal Cashflow Pause — $0/mo): If this is simply a temporary budget or timing crunch, we can place your account on a $0/month 60-Day Pause instead of cancelling—preserving all your historical data, grandfathered pricing ([CURRENT_RATE]), and custom configurations for when you're ready.     3. Flexible Option B (Maintenance Lite Step-Down Tier): We can step your plan down to our [LITE_TIER_NAME] at [LITE_TIER_PRICE]/mo so your core systems remain protected at a fraction of the cost.      If you still prefer to complete a full close-out, just reply "CLOSE" and we will prepare a clean, organized handoff package of all your files and records by [HANDOFF_DATE]. If you'd like to use Option A (Pause) or Option B (Lite Tier)—or chat for 5 minutes—just reply here!      With gratitude,     [OWNER_NAME]     Founder, [COMPANY_NAME] | [OWNER_DIRECT_PHONE] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], [OWNER_NAME] (Founder at [COMPANY_NAME]) here. I saw your cancellation request and confirmed it so you won't be billed unexpectedly. I just sent a quick personal email with a $0 60-Day Pause option (to keep your grandfathered rate & setup) or a full clean handoff—let me know which you prefer! || INTERNAL NOTE: ⚠️ VIP CANCELLATION SAVE BRIDGE — Client: [CUSTOMER_COMPANY] (MRR: [MONTHLY_VALUE] | Tenure: [TENURE_MONTHS]m) | Billing paused; Executive Save Email (Pause / Lite Step-Down options) sent by @[OWNER_NAME].
Expected_Output_Schema: Synchronized Email Subject/Body + 160-char SMS/WhatsApp + Slack Internal Escalation Alert
Verification_Gate_Checklist: Acknowledge the request graciously within **30 minutes**—never trap a client in hostile "dark-pattern" cancellation hoops, as how you handle a pause/exit determines whether they stay or return in 90 days. | Offer a concrete **"Pause / Step-Down / Executive Tune-Up" Save Bridge** before finalizing termination.

Title: Urgent Staff Handoff & Out-of-Office Emergency Coverage Briefing Script

Because we have a "Zero-Drop Handoff" standard here at [COMPANY_NAME], your [PROJECT_OR_ACCOUNT_NAME] has already been fully briefed and transitioned to [BACKUP_LEAD_NAME] ([BACKUP_LEAD_TITLE], CC'd on this email) so your timeline doesn't miss a beat.      Here is where your current deliverables stand for this week:     • Completed & Verified: [COMPLETED_ITEM_SUMMARY]     • In Progress (On Track for [DUE_DATE]): [ACTIVE_DELIVERABLE_SUMMARY]     • Anything Needed From You: [CLIENT_ACTION_OR_NONE]      [BACKUP_LEAD_NAME] has full access to all of your project notes and SOPs in our system. Simply reply-all to this thread or reach [BACKUP_LEAD_NAME] directly at [BACKUP_LEAD_PHONE] if you need anything at all this week!      Best regards,     [OWNER_OR_OPS_DIRECTOR_NAME]     [COMPANY_NAME] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], quick heads-up from [COMPANY_NAME]: [ORIGINAL_STAFF_NAME] is out on unexpected leave through [RETURN_DATE]. [BACKUP_LEAD_NAME] ([BACKUP_LEAD_TITLE]) has already been 100% briefed on your [PROJECT_OR_ACCOUNT_NAME] so everything stays right on schedule for [DUE_DATE]! || INTERNAL NOTE: 🔄 EMERGENCY PORTFOLIO HANDOFF — Covering for: [ORIGINAL_STAFF_NAME] ([START_DATE]–[RETURN_DATE]) | Backup Lead: @[BACKUP_LEAD_NAME] | [ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_COUNT] active client threads re-routed in HelpScout/Slack and ClickUp tasks reassigned.

Verification_Gate_Checklist: Run a 1-click query in ClickUp/Asana/CRM to export all `Active_Onboarding` and `In_Progress` accounts assigned to the absent team member into a **Coverage Handoff Brief**. | Proactively introduce the backup point of contact to active clients *before* a client email sits unanswered in an out-of-office inbox.

Title: Annual Price Increase & Service Tier Upgrade Customer Notification Script

Full_Prompt_Or_Script_Body: SUBJECT: Your 2027 [COMPANY_NAME] Account Review & Loyalty Rate Lock Options || EMAIL: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME],      As we wrap up the quarter, I wanted to thank you for trusting [COMPANY_NAME] with [CUSTOMER_COMPANY]'s [SERVICE_CATEGORY] over the past year.      Looking back at your account log over the last 12 months, our team was proud to deliver:     • [ANNUAL_VALUE_METRIC_1]     • [ANNUAL_VALUE_METRIC_2]      To continue investing in top-tier [TECHNICIANS_CLINICIANS_SPECIALISTS], expanded [NEW_CAPABILITY_ADDED_THIS_YEAR], and our 60-second priority response guarantee, we are updating our standard service rates effective [EFFECTIVE_DATE] (our first adjustment in [MONTHS_SINCE_LAST_INCREASE] months).      Because you are an existing valued client, you have two preferential options before the new public rates take effect:      • Option 1 — Loyalty Rate-Lock (Keep Your Current [CURRENT_RATE] Rate for Another [LOCK_DURATION_MONTHS] Months):       If you confirm your renewal [or enroll in automated ACH billing] before [EARLY_LOCK_DEADLINE], we will waive the 2027 rate adjustment and lock in your current [CURRENT_RATE] rate through [RATE_LOCK_EXPIRATION_DATE].       -> Click here to lock in your current rate in 15 seconds: [ONE_CLICK_LOYALTY_LOCK_URL]      • Option 2 — Standard Month-to-Month Continuation ([NEW_ADJUSTED_RATE] Effective [EFFECTIVE_DATE]):       No action is needed on your part! If you prefer to remain on flexible month-to-month terms without a renewal lock, your plan will automatically transition to [NEW_ADJUSTED_RATE] (+[INCREASE_PCT]%) on your [EFFECTIVE_DATE] billing cycle, including full access to [NEW_CAPABILITY_ADDED_THIS_YEAR].      Thank you again for being part of the [COMPANY_NAME] family. Please reply directly to me if you have any questions!      Warm regards,     [OWNER_NAME]     Founder, [COMPANY_NAME] || SMS: Hi [CUSTOMER_FIRST_NAME], [OWNER_NAME] at [COMPANY_NAME] here! Ahead of our [EFFECTIVE_DATE] rate update, we set aside a Loyalty Rate-Lock so you can keep your current [CURRENT_RATE] price for another [LOCK_DURATION_MONTHS] mos if confirmed by [EARLY_LOCK_DEADLINE]. Lock it in 1-click here: [ONE_CLICK_LOYALTY_LOCK_URL] || INTERNAL NOTE: 📈 ANNUAL RATE ADJUSTMENT & LOYALTY LOCK SENT — Cohort: [COHORT_NAME] ([ACCOUNT_COUNT] accounts) | Effective Date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE] (+[INCREASE_PCT]%) | Loyalty Lock Deadline: [EARLY_LOCK_DEADLINE]. Track 1-click lock conversions in `Q4_Renewal_Tracker`.

Verification_Gate_Checklist: Anchor the communication on **verified value delivered over the past 12 months** and **new service enhancements** added to their tier—never lead with *"Everything is getting more expensive for us."* | Offer a **Grandfathered Early-Renewal Lock** for clients who confirm their annual renewal or autopay enrollment prior to the deadline.
